name: Jarvis Event Emitter
description: Emits OpenClaw lifecycle events (message_received, message_sent, before_agent_start, agent_end, before_tool_call) to stdout as JSONL and optionally POSTs to an HTTP sink for ingestion by the Jarvis cognition layer.

enabled.description: Master toggle. When false, no events are emitted.

stdoutEnabled.description: Emit each event as a JSONL line to stdout (default: true). Picked up by Docker logging.

httpSinkUrl.description: Optional HTTP POST target. Each event is POSTed as JSON. Failures logged but never throw (hook chain stays alive).

redactPayloadHash.description: When true (default), message bodies and exec params are SHA-256 hashed before emission. When false, raw values are emitted (DO NOT use in production — for debugging only).

subscribeEvents.description: Which lifecycle events to subscribe to. Defaults to all five.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Master toggle. Disable to stop emitting events without uninstalling the plugin.

stdoutEnabled.label: Emit to stdout
stdoutEnabled.help: Write each event as a JSONL line to stdout (captured by Docker logs).

httpSinkUrl.label: HTTP Sink URL
httpSinkUrl.help: Optional HTTP POST endpoint that receives each event as JSON. Use http://cognition-svc:3030/events when sidecar is running.

redactPayloadHash.label: Hash Payloads
redactPayloadHash.help: SHA-256 hash message bodies and exec params before emitting. Recommended ON in production.
